name: Slider
description: A range slider for numbers (0 to 100, $0 to $5,000, 1 to 10) with a value bubble, mark labels such as Low / Medium / High and an optional box for exact entry.

props.name: step
props.label: Step
props.description: The slider moves in steps of this size (1, 5, 0.5, …).

props.name: value_suffix
props.label: Suffix (unit)
props.description: Shown after the value, e.g. % or kg.

props.name: marks
props.label: Mark labels
props.description: Labels spread evenly under the track, lowest first (e.g. Low, Medium, High). Without marks the minimum and maximum are shown.

props.name: show_input
props.label: Show number box
props.description: A small number box beside the slider for typing an exact value.

props.name: default_value
props.label: Starting position
props.description: Where the slider starts. The field stays empty until the person moves it (or presses Enter).

accessibility.keyboard: Tab to the slider; Left / Right (or Up / Down) move one step, Page Up / Page Down move further, Home / End jump to the minimum / maximum. Enter or Space accepts the starting position while the field is still empty. With the number box, Tab again to type an exact value.

author: UserTasks
